resolved_conflicts.explanation: Three sources (NHLR, Idaho Heritage Trust, Forest Lookouts) give 1934; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1933; Keeping Watch gives 1933 or 1934. The record keeps 1934 as the majority date and the story says the other years are given.
NHLR, Forest Lookouts and Keeping Watch call it an L-4 cab; Idaho Heritage Trust calls it an R4-80 standard plan lookout. The sources do not explain how the two labels relate, so both are recorded.
Idaho Heritage Trust says eight miles north of Stanley; firelookout.com says nine miles. The story uses eight and notes the other figure.

NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts say the Forest Service restoration was completed in 2008; Forest Lookouts says restoration was begun in 2008 and would be placed in the rental program when completed. Not settled by the sources.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1933 vs 1934), the design label (L-4 vs R4-80), and the 2008 restoration (completed vs begun) are disputed across sources. Current rental or visiting status is not established: no recreation.gov listing was checked, and the Idaho Fire Lookouts 'Drive-Up Emergency' label is the only current-status hint. Staffing as_of 2021 comes from Keeping Watch's item date. The record's status 'standing' is supported by the 2021 interior video. No corrections proposed to the brief record.
